messages.subject: Alternative theme doesnt seem to work with selectinput
parts:

Does anyone know a solution for this issue?

parts: ah I see. I did have some problems as well with selectinput .The most recent versions of Shiny use selectize.js , which has its own css rules. Particularity annoying is that in some instances the z-index of the selectize inputs are wrong i.e. when you open a menu (say navbar) the input selector stays on top of the navbar items by which you can't see some of the items anymore.
